title: SimOPD: Relational Knowledge Transfer for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A key challenge in on-policy distillation (OPD) is extracting effective supervision from teacher knowledge. Supervision from token probabilities may underutilize internal knowledge, while direct hidden-state matching forces the student to shift to the teacher's feature space and complicates cross-architecture transfer. Inspired by contrastive learning's use of relationships between instances, we propose \textbf{SimOPD} to transfer teacher internal knowledge through response similarities. Specifically, SimOPD uses paired memory banks of student-generated responses to extract supervision from the teacher's internal representations as similarity distributions. The student then matches these distributions within its own representation space, retaining representational freedom and removing the need for cross-model projection. Extensive experiments show that SimOPD improves the overall average over the strongest baselines by up to 2.6 and 3.1

translated_title: SimOPD：面向在线策略蒸馏的关系知识迁移
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的一个关键挑战是如何从教师知识中提取有效的监督信号。基于词元概率的监督可能无法充分利用教师内部知识，而直接的隐藏状态匹配则会迫使学生模型转向教师的特征空间，并使跨架构迁移变得复杂。受对比学习利用实例间关系的启发，我们提出SimOPD，通过响应相似性来迁移教师的内部知识。具体而言，SimOPD使用由学生生成响应构成的成对记忆库，从教师的内部表示中提取监督信号，将其表示为相似性分布。随后，学生在自己的表示空间内匹配这些分布，从而保留了表示自由度，并消除了对跨模型投影的需求。大量实验表明，SimOPD相对于最强基线将整体平均性能最多提升了2.6和3.1。
tldr: 提出SimOPD方法，通过成对记忆库将教师内部表示转化为响应相似性分布，并让学生在自身表示空间内进行匹配，从而实现无需跨模型投影的在线策略蒸馏关系知识迁移。
en_tdlr: SimOPD enables relational knowledge transfer for on-policy distillation by extracting teacher internal representations as similarity distributions over student-generated responses, which the student matches within its own representation space, eliminating the need for cross-model projection.
